On The 6 th Of January, 2026
 Misc. Criminal Case No. 59867 of 2025
 Jittu @ Jitendra Choudhary
 Versus
 The State Of Madhya Pradesh

Appearance:
 Shri Rambihari Gautam - Advocate for the applicant.
 Shri Himanshu Tiwari - Panel Lawyer for the State.

Order 
This is first bail application filed by the applicant under Section 483 of the Bharatiya Nagrik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 for grant of regular bail relating to FIR/Crime No. 194/2024 registered at Police Station - Tilwara, district - Jabalpur for the offences punishable under Sections 363, 366 Ka,
376 (DA) of the IPC and 5 (g) of the POCSO Act.

The applicant is in custody since 12.03.2025.
2.
The counsel for the applicant submits that it is a case of bail jump.

Initially, the present applicant was released on bail on 22.10.2024, however, as he could not enter his appearance before the trial Court during trial on 27.12.2024, thereafter a perpetual warrant of arrest was issued against him and in execution of the same the applicant was arrested and produced before the trial Court and sent to the jail.

It is contended that the applicant was not intimated by the counsel as regards the date of appearance before the trial NEUTRAL CITATION NO.
2026:MPHC-JBP:695 2 MCRC-59867-2025 Court, therefore, he could not mark his presence.
It is submitted that the lapse was bonafide and inadvertent.
Now the applicant shall ensure his appearance before the trial Court personally or through his counsel on each and every date and shall not seek unnecessary adjournments.
The applicant is in custody since 12.03.2025 and trial would take considerable time to conclude, therefore, the applicant be released on bail.
3. The counsel for the State has opposed the application.

4. Heard the submissions and perused the case diary.

sentences.text: Considering the totality of the circumstances and the fact that earlier the applicant was released on bail, this Court finds it to be a fit case to release the applicant on bail.
Therefore, without commenting on the merit of the case, the application is allowed.

6. It is directed that the applicant shall be released on bail on furnishing a personal bond in a sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand Only) with one surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court concerned for his appearance before the said Court on all such dates as may be fixed by that Court in this regard during the pendency of trial.
7. It is further directed that the applicant shall comply with the provisions of Section 480(3) of the Bharatiya Nagrik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023.

(SANDEEP N. BHATT) JUDGE ks Jittu @ Jitendra Choudhary vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 6 January, 2026 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/3881087/
